source.citation: Florence Scovel Shinn, "I never saw so many mis-fit sailor hats", pen and ink drawing for "From a Steamer Chair", Century Magazine 68:160 (May 1904). Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division, Cabinet of American Illustration, CAI - Shinn, no. 5, LC-USZ62-82966 (item 2010717915).
what_it_does_not_supply: anything about Chicago, the Glessner household or Christine Nelson
what_it_supplies: the flat crown, straight brim and dark band of a woman's sailor hat in 1904, and how it sat on drawn-up hair
